answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 5676 Country: India Title: I have named my daughter as Mehwish, I wanted to know if its islamically premitted or not? Question: I have named my daughter as Mehwish, I wanted to know if its islamically premitted or not? Answer ID: 5676 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 787/722=D) Mahwish ( مہ وش ) means: a person with face like moon. You can keep this name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
